title: Nutty Smoky Moroccan Lamb Mechoui
description: A smoky and silky Moroccan dish featuring lamb, flaked almonds, and confit tomato, perfect for a solo dinner, with an ayurvedic rajasic friendly twist.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together smoked paprika, ground cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Rub the spice mixture all over the lamb shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, then remove it from the pot and set it aside.
Add the confit tomato to the pot and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the flaked almonds to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Return the lamb shoulder to the pot and add the chopped parsley and lemon juice.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the lamb for 2 1/2 hours, or until it is tender and falls apart easily.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
